validated_objective: Deliver the first v0.4.1 fixture coverage expansion by generalizing retained negative fixture execution beyond quality-gate and proving it on selected existing verifier surfaces.
scope: Add a generalized retained fixture manifest and runner support for at least qif-package and expert-judgment negative fixtures.
Keep the existing quality-gate fixture corpus and drift check intact.
Update npm test, changelog, roadmap/runtime log, and QIF/AOF evidence.
constraints: Do not redesign QIF concepts, schemas, or semantic meaning unless required to make existing rules executable.
Do not build UI or external integrations.
Do not claim verifier success proves semantic quality truth.
expected_outcomes: npm test fails if selected non-quality-gate verifier rules are weakened or deleted.
v0.4.1 has clear evidence that QIF Phase 1 fixture coverage expanded beyond quality-gate.
